author: Rayzurbock
releaseNotes: v1.3.1: Schedule rules can now fire at multiple times per day (one rule with several times instead of one rule per time) — time picker plus an 'Additional times' field in the editor, or a 'scheduleTimes' list via the API. Rule editor fields now show '(optional)' wherever they aren't required, and action-builder fields become required based on the action type picked.
